Questions
## Frequently asked questions
How far in advance should I book?
Same-day rides are often possible. Booking 24 hours ahead secures the vehicle and chauffeur, especially during the WM Phoenix Open, Barrett-Jackson and Spring Training.
How many passengers and bags fit in one vehicle?
Up to six passengers with their luggage in one GMC Yukon XL Denali. For larger groups we send more than one vehicle. Send us the head count and we quote the whole group.
Do you serve Paradise Valley, Tempe and the East Valley?
Yes. We cover the whole Phoenix metro: Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Phoenix, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Cave Creek, Carefree and Fountain Hills, including airport runs from any of them.
Are child seats available?
Yes, on request. Tell us the child's age when you book so the right seat is installed before pickup.
How do I pay?
You get one flat price before the ride, with no surge pricing. Major cards are accepted. Payment details come with your quote.
What is your cancellation policy?
Let us know as early as you can. The cancellation terms for your booking are included with your quote.
Is there an hourly minimum?
Hourly service is quoted per booking. Send us the plan for the day and we confirm the hours and the rate.
Are your chauffeurs licensed and insured?
Yes. Comfort Luxury Rides is a licensed Arizona business with professional chauffeurs and insured vehicles.
About

Comfort Luxury Rides was founded in 2020 by Ergi Janku, CEO and Managing Director, on four commitments: punctuality, privacy, exclusivity and professionalism.
The company is small and owner-run. The person who quotes your ride is the person responsible for it.

## Scottsdale to PHX Airport Car Service | Comfort Luxury Rides
https://comfortluxuryrides.com/airport-car-service/

Home
Airport car service
Airport transfers · 24/7
Airport car service from Scottsdale to PHX, SDL and AZA
Chauffeured transfers to and from Sky Harbor, Scottsdale Airport, Mesa Gateway and Deer Valley, from anywhere in the Valley. The pickup is timed to your flight and the price is fixed before you book.
Get an airport quote Call (586) 222-4809
Flat rate, no surge Red-eyes and holidays Up to 6 passengers with bags
Scottsdale Airport (SDL)
Airport pickups
## How a pickup works
What happens between landing and getting into the car.
### Send the flight number
We follow the arrival time and move the pickup with it. If the flight is early or late, the car is still at the terminal when you land.
### Walk out to the meeting point
Your chauffeur texts the pickup spot before you land: the arrivals curb outside baggage claim, or inside the terminal if you prefer. Luggage goes in the cargo bay.
### Ride home at the price you were quoted
One flat price, agreed when you booked. No meter and no surge pricing during Spring Training or on a holiday weekend.
The airports
## The airports we serve
### PHXPhoenix Sky Harbor International
The main airport for the Valley, about 25 minutes from central Scottsdale outside peak traffic. Both terminals, 3 and 4, are covered. Curbside pickup is standard; tell us if you want your chauffeur inside at baggage claim.
### SDLScottsdale Airport and private aviation
One of the busiest private-jet airports in the country, minutes from North Scottsdale, Kierland and the resorts along Scottsdale Road. We collect at the FBO terminals, including Signature, Atlantic and Jet Aviation, and coordinate the timing with your crew or handler.
### AZAPhoenix-Mesa Gateway
The East Valley airport, about 35 miles from Scottsdale. Popular for low-cost carriers and for Chandler, Gilbert and Mesa pickups, and quoted at a flat rate.
### DVTPhoenix Deer Valley
General aviation in North Phoenix, close to Desert Ridge, Cave Creek and Carefree. Private arrivals are met on the ramp side or at the terminal, whichever your operator prefers.
Travel times
## Drive times to PHX
Typical drive times to Sky Harbor from the places we pick up most. Add time for rush hour and for big event weekends, and allow the airline's recommended arrival margin on top.
Send us the flight and the pickup address and we set the pickup time.

Who rides with us
## Who books airport transfers
### Resort and hotel guests
Pickups at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess, The Phoenician, Four Seasons Troon North, the Biltmore and every resort in between, for the flight in and the flight home.
### Business travellers
A quiet cabin and a driver who knows the terminals. Assistants can book by email or WhatsApp and get one confirmation back. See corporate transportation.
### Families and golf groups
Six seats, a full cargo bay for golf bags and suitcases, and rear climate control for the summer. For bigger parties we send a second vehicle.
Airport questions
## Before you book
Do you track my flight?
Yes. Give us the flight number when you book and we time the pickup to the actual arrival. If the flight lands early or late, the car moves with it.
Where do I meet my chauffeur at PHX Sky Harbor?
Your chauffeur texts the exact pickup point before you land: the arrivals curb outside your terminal's baggage claim, or a meet inside the terminal if you ask for it. Terminals 3 and 4 are both covered.
Can you pick up at Scottsdale Airport's private terminals?
Yes. We collect from the FBO terminals at Scottsdale Airport (SDL), including Signature, Atlantic and Jet Aviation, and coordinate the pickup time with your flight crew or handler.
Is the airport price a flat rate?
Yes. Every airport transfer is quoted as one flat price before you book, based on the pickup address and the airport. There is no meter and no surge pricing at busy times.
How much does a car service from Scottsdale to PHX cost?
Every airport transfer is a flat price based on the pickup area, the time and the number of vehicles, so we do not publish a rate card. Send the pickup address and the flight and we reply with the price, usually within the hour. The price you are quoted is the price you pay.

Booking
## How companies book with us
Most corporate rides are booked by assistants and travel coordinators, so the process is short and confirmed in writing.
### One message to book
Email or WhatsApp the itinerary: names, pickup, drop-off, times. We confirm with one reply and send the chauffeur's details before the ride.
### Predictable pricing
Flat quotes per transfer or per hour, agreed in advance, so expense reports are clean and approvals are quick. Regular accounts can be invoiced monthly.
### Discretion as standard
The chauffeur drives and does not make conversation unless you start it. Calls stay private and the cabin is quiet enough to work in.
What we run

Airport runs for visiting executives at PHX Sky Harbor and the private terminals at Scottsdale Airport

Venues and events
## Where we take you
Stadiums, ballparks, golf tournaments, resorts and Old Town. We know the drop zones and the pickup points at each.
### Game day
State Farm Stadium for the Cardinals in Glendale, Footprint Center for the Suns and Chase Field for the Diamondbacks downtown, and Spring Training at Salt River Fields, Scottsdale Stadium and the Cactus League ballparks. Drop at the gate, pickup at the gate.
### WM Phoenix Open and Barrett-Jackson
TPC Scottsdale every winter for the Open, WestWorld for the collector-car auction. The flat price is the same on the busiest weekend of the year.
### Weddings
Couples, parents and out-of-town guests moved between hotel, ceremony and reception across Scottsdale, Paradise Valley and Phoenix, timed to the ceremony and the reception.
### Nights out in Old Town
Dinner in Old Town Scottsdale, a bar on Saddlebag Trail, then home to North Scottsdale or Tempe. Book by the hour and the car stays with you; book point to point and we come back when you call.
### Concerts, shows and galas
Talking Stick Resort, Arizona Financial Theatre, Desert Diamond Arena in Glendale, and the resort galas and charity dinners along Scottsdale Road and Camelback.
### Golf groups and celebrations
Tee times at Troon North, Grayhawk and TPC with the golf bags in the cargo bay. Birthdays, bachelor and bachelorette parties and anniversaries, with nobody needing to drive.
Two ways to book

One flat price each way. Best when the start and end times are fixed: a game, a concert, a wedding ceremony. We drop you at the entrance and are back at the agreed time or when you text.

Event questions
## Before you book
Do you drive to Cardinals, Suns and Diamondbacks games?
Yes. State Farm Stadium in Glendale, Footprint Center and Chase Field downtown, and Spring Training ballparks including Salt River Fields and Scottsdale Stadium. We drop at the gate and pick up at an agreed point when the game ends.
Can you take us to the WM Phoenix Open and Barrett-Jackson?
Yes. TPC Scottsdale for the Open and WestWorld for Barrett-Jackson, every winter. The flat price is the same on those weekends as on any other. Book early, because those dates fill up.
Do you do weddings?
Yes. Couples, parents and guests between hotel, ceremony and reception across Scottsdale, Paradise Valley and Phoenix, timed to the day. For wedding parties larger than six we send more than one vehicle.
Is it better to book by the hour for a night out?
For a night with several stops, yes: the chauffeur waits between venues and the car stays with you. For one drop-off and one pickup, point to point is simpler and priced per transfer.

Sunset, Phoenix
How hourly works
## How hourly service works
Point-to-point rides are priced by the journey. Hourly service is priced by time, and the chauffeur and vehicle stay with you for all of it.
### Tell us the start and a rough plan
Start time, pickup address, roughly how long and roughly where. We quote one hourly rate and confirm the hours with you before anything is booked.
### The chauffeur stays with you
Between stops the car waits where you left it, with the air running and your bags locked inside. There is no re-booking at each stop.
### Extend on the day
If the day runs long, tell the chauffeur and the booking extends at the same rate, subject to availability.
Built for days like these
## What people book hourly for
### Golf days
Troon North, TPC Scottsdale, Grayhawk, We-Ko-Pa and The Boulders. Clubs go in the cargo bay, and the car is cool after the round.
### Dinners and shopping
Scottsdale Fashion Square, Kierland Commons and Scottsdale Quarter, the galleries of Old Town, dinner along Camelback. The bags stay in the car.
### Arizona day trips
The red rocks of Sedona, Jerome and the Verde Valley, the Apache Trail, Tucson. Quoted by the hour or as a day rate, with a chauffeur who has driven the road before.
### Resort days
From the Fairmont Princess, The Phoenician or Four Seasons to the spa, a lunch reservation, a gallery opening and back, without waiting for a rideshare in the heat.
### Showing people around
Visiting family, relocating executives, prospective buyers on a property tour: one car, one driver, every stop on the list.
### Multi-stop evenings
Pre-dinner drinks, the restaurant, a show at Talking Stick, a last stop in Old Town. The same vehicle all night, waiting outside each door. See event transportation.
Hourly versus a string of rideshares
## Hourly service versus rideshares
No re-booking at every stop, and the same driver all day
Your bags, clubs and coats stay locked in the vehicle between stops
A chauffeur who knows the Valley's freeways, the back routes and the valet entrances
One hourly rate agreed before the day
Six seats, so the whole party moves together

Hourly questions
## Before you book
Is there a minimum number of hours?
Hourly bookings are quoted per request. Tell us the start time and a rough plan for the day, and we confirm the hours and the rate together before you commit.
Can we go outside Scottsdale and Phoenix?
Yes. Day trips to Sedona, Tucson, Jerome, the Apache Trail and other Arizona destinations are quoted on request as hourly or as a fixed day rate, whichever suits the plan better.
Can the chauffeur make stops and wait?
Yes. Within the booked time the chauffeur makes as many stops as you like and waits at each one, with your bags locked in the vehicle.

## Before you book
What vehicles do you use?
Black GMC Yukon XL Denali SUVs: full-size, extended length, leather seating for up to six passengers, with a cargo bay behind the third row.
How many passengers and bags fit?
Up to six passengers with their luggage, golf bags included. For seven or more we send two or more vehicles together.
Are the vehicles cleaned between rides?
Yes. Every vehicle is cleaned and detailed before each ride, inside and out, and no smoking is allowed at any time.
Do you have sedans, limousines or sprinter vans?
No. We run one class of vehicle, the Yukon XL Denali, so every booking gets the same standard. For larger groups we add vehicles rather than change class.

The company
## What we do and how we work
Airport transfers, corporate travel, event transportation and hourly chauffeur service, all in the same class of vehicle and to the same four commitments.
### Punctuality
The chauffeur arrives before the pickup time. Airport pickups are timed to the flight, not to the schedule printed on the ticket.
### Privacy
What is said in the car stays in the car. The chauffeur does not make conversation unless you start it, and does not discuss clients.
### Exclusivity
One client per booking. The vehicle is yours for the transfer or for the hours you book, and it does not pick anyone else up on the way.
### Professionalism
Business attire, a clean vehicle, and a route planned before the pickup. The price is agreed in writing before the ride.
## Ergi Janku, CEO and Managing Director
Ergi founded Comfort Luxury Rides in 2020 and runs it day to day: the quotes, the bookings and the standard every chauffeur works to.
Because the company is small and owner-run, the person who quotes your ride is the person responsible for it. Questions about a booking reach the owner, not a call centre.
Contact us

## What this website does not do
It sets no cookies and runs no analytics or advertising scripts.
It loads no fonts, scripts or images from third-party servers. Everything on the page is served from this site.
It does not profile you, track you across other sites, or sell or share your information with anyone for marketing.
## The quote form
When you send the form on the Get a quote page, you give us: your name, phone number, email address if you choose to add it, the type of ride, the pickup date and time, the pickup and drop-off addresses, the number of passengers, a flight number if relevant, and anything you write in the notes.
The form is delivered to our email inbox by Web3Forms, a form-processing service based in the United States, which transmits the submission and does not use it for its own purposes. We use what you send only to reply with a quote and, if you book, to arrange and carry out the ride.
We keep form submissions and the related emails for as long as we need them for the booking and for our business records, then delete them. You can ask us to delete your details at any time by emailing comfortluxuryrides@gmail.com.
## Phone, WhatsApp and email
If you call, text, email or message us on WhatsApp, we keep the conversation for as long as we need it to handle your booking. WhatsApp (Meta Platforms) and your phone and email providers process those messages under their own privacy policies.
## Server logs
This site is hosted on GitHub Pages and served through Cloudflare. Like every web host, they keep standard server logs, which include the IP address and browser of each visitor, for security and to keep the service running. We do not receive or use those logs to identify you.
## Links to other sites
The site links to Google, Yelp, Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp. Those sites have their own privacy policies, and we do not control what they collect.
## Your rights
You can ask us what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email comfortluxuryrides@gmail.com and we will reply within a reasonable time.
## Changes
If this policy changes, the new version is published on this page with a new effective date.
